notes.title: Gray Dawn Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32701555/bfd775a2e2cfeb543629056248b933c59024899b.jpg[/img]
Thank you guys for supporting our game and for very positive feedback! 
We are grateful to you for this, and, as a thank you, we want to present a new update of the game. We hope you enjoy it, and if you find a problem, just let us know about it! God bless you!
Update contains:
►Correction of bugs
►Russian language (subtitles and translation of the menu) for all Russian-speaking fans from the wonderful team The Bullfinch Team.

notes.title: Gray Dawn UPDATE!
notes.content:
Thank you very much, guys, for supporting Gray Dawn! As you see now, the game has received Very Positive reviews and that's just because of you! As a token of gratitude, we want to present you with the first update of the game. Hope you enjoy it and please if you encounter problems let us know! God bless!
The update contains:
*controller support
*achievements
*German, Romanian, Hungarian subtitles

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32701555/eb31f8c1d094e470967ce822e46b92ad16d9126c.png[/img]

notes.title: The Wait is Almost Over! Gray Dawn is Coming Out June 7th, 2018.
notes.content:
[i]The end of all things is near; therefore, be of sound judgment and sober spirit for the purpose of prayer.
- 1 Peter 4:7[/i]

I know you've been anxiously waiting for a release date. Well, I'm here to finally tell you that Gray Dawn is coming out June 7th, 2018! So, go and grab your exorcism tools. It's almost time for you to immerse yourself in the world of Gray Dawn and find out the mystery behind the missing altar boy. 

We also have just released 8 minutes of  gameplay footage for you to view: 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S-PIyW33ML8

To stay up to date on all things Gray Dawn, make sure you’re following our [url=https://www.facebook.com/GrayDawnGame]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/StoneInteract]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/interactivestone/]Instagram[/url], and join our [url=http://eepurl.com/ds9ee5]Newsletter[/url].

notes.title: Your Prayers Have Been Answered! Gray Dawn Is Coming Out This June!
notes.content:
[i]Be patient, therefore, brothers, until the coming of the Lord. See how the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient about it, until it receives the early and the late rains
- James 5:7[/i]

We know that waiting can be Hell, but your patience will soon pay off! Gray Dawn will be coming out this June on PC! You can finally experience the real and unreal universes of Gray Dawn and embark on the journey to help Father Abraham prove himself innocent. 

Want to get further in the mood, watch our newest gameplay trailer now: 

https://youtu.be/6L9-xv5qa_I

Also, don’t forget to follow us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/GrayDawnGame]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/StoneInteract]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/interactivestone/]Instagram[/url], and join our [url=http://eepurl.com/ds9ee5]Newsletter[/url] for the latest news on Gray Dawn!

Stay Tuned, 
Father Abraham

notes.title: Gray Dawn: An All New Religious Horror Game Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32701555/fee77b8b6bd7afc71eda7d73b5194a05edbad372.jpg[/img]

[i]And he who was seated on the throne said, “Behold, I am making all things new.” Also he said, “Write this down, for these words are trustworthy and true.”
- Revelation 21:5[/i]

Welcome to Gray Dawn, a first-person horror game where you play as a Swedish-born priest that is on a quest to prove his innocence! 

We are excited to announce that Gray Dawn will be blessing your screens this Q2 2018! If you want to keep up to date with all our exciting happenings, remember to follow us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/GrayDawnGame]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/StoneInteract]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/interactivestone/]Instagram[/url], and join our [url=http://eepurl.com/ds9ee5]Newsletter[/url]! We’ll be posting teaser images, trailers, gameplay videos, and much more in the days to come. You won’t want to miss all our horrific goodies. 

We also want to give you a sneak peak for what’s to come ːsteamhappyː

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=czlW3hnprZo&t=3s

Thanks for your support, 
Father Abraham
